name: MortgageApplication
description: Core aggregate for a residential mortgage application. Created when a personal customer initiates a mortgage enquiry (PH-009, JRN-006). Tracks the complete application lifecycle from enquiry through DIP, full application, valuation, underwriting, offer, and completion. Owned exclusively by SVC-002 (Mortgage Service).

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: property_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. UK address object: line1, city, postcode (UK format), country_code (GB only).

fields.name: purchase_price
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP, max 2 decimal places.

fields.name: deposit_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP. Must be >= 5% of purchase_price.

fields.name: loan_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP. Derived: purchase_price - deposit_amount.

fields.name: ltv_ratio
fields.validation_rule: Required. loan_amount / min(purchase_price, valuation_amount) × 100. Updated post-valuation.

fields.name: product_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. Valid active product in SVC-002 product catalogue.

fields.name: application_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: purchase | remortgage | buy_to_let | shared_ownership.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Full status machine: enquiry | dip_pending | dip_issued | dip_expired | dip_declined | full_application_submitted | documents_complete | valuation_pending | valuation_complete | underwriting | approved | referred | declined | offer_issued | offer_accepted | offer_expired | completed | withdrawn.

fields.name: dip_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601. Set when status = dip_issued.

fields.name: full_application_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601. Set when full application submitted. Must be <= dip_expiry.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any mutation.

relationships.description: MortgageApplication belongs to one Customer. Cross-service reference (SVC-001 owns ENT-001).
MortgageApplication has multiple AffordabilityAssessments (one per stage: dip, full_application).
MortgageApplication has at most one active MortgageOffer.
